What you'll receive. Kentico Software s.r.o. will send you the Kentico Community newsletter, about monthly, plus occasional emails about community events, Kentico's Community programs, surveys, and Kentico Community portal updates. We won't send Kentico product, sales or partner marketing based on this subscription.

How you subscribe. From the sign-up form, we send a confirmation link to your address, and you're subscribed only after you click it. Members who opt in at registration are subscribed when they confirm their email address. Members can also subscribe from their account page.

What we keep. Your email address, your name if you're a member, when you subscribed and confirmed, and which emails were sent to you. Every email has a tracking image and tracked links, so we record whether and when you opened it and which links you clicked, linked to the email sent to you. Copies of sent emails are kept for 14 days. If you've allowed website tracking in Cookie settings, opens and clicks are also linked to your visitor record. See Privacy.

Unsubscribe. Use the link in any email, or your account page. You'll stop receiving these emails right away. We keep a record that you unsubscribed so we don't email you again by mistake.

Sharing. We don't sell or share your email address with third parties for their own marketing.
ConsentLanguageVersion.ShortText: Get Kentico Community news and updates: the community newsletter, plus occasional emails about community events, Kentico's Community programs, surveys, and portal updates. Unsubscribe anytime. Privacy
